### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `Price.java` directly addresses a bug that caused `Price.toString()` to fail under certain conditions (specifically, when the division resulted in a non-terminating decimal). The change to use `MathContext.DECIMAL32` ensures that the division operation can handle such cases without throwing an exception. 

The new test case in `PriceTest.java` is designed to validate this fix by simulating a scenario that previously caused the failure. By ensuring that the `toString()` method does not throw an exception for the specific case of 1 divided by 3, the test confirms that the modification in `Price.java` effectively resolves the issue. Thus, the test serves as a safeguard against future regressions related to this bug.

Avoid Price.toString() failing for certain values of
 numerator/denominator.

Fixes a regression introduced in 66cc533 (bugfix #479) in which the
numerator/denominator division fails with an ArithmeticException if no
MathContext is provided. BigDecimal tries to return an exact result,
which is not possible when rounding and precision aren't specified.

See BigDecimal javadoc:
http://docs.oracle.com/javase/7/docs/api/java/math/BigDecimal.html

Fixes Crashlitics issue #196
https://fabric.io/gnucash/android/apps/org.gnucash.android/issues/571b4a95ffcdc04250f98ba0

This omission led to an `ArithmeticException` when the division resulted in a non-terminating decimal expansion, as `BigDecimal` attempts to return an exact result by default.

